mapper.sql: select diagnosis_id, cat_id, base_id, source_base_id, ward_id, visit_date, visit_type, doctor, doctor_user_id, symptoms, diagnosis_result, weight, check_items, medical_advice, check_photos, correction_note, correction_by, correction_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from cat_diagnosis
mapper.select:
AND del_flag = '0'
order by diagnosis_id desc

select t.cat_id as catId, t.visit_count as visitCount, t.initial_count as initialCount, t.first_visit as firstVisitDate, t.last_visit as lastVisitTime, t.doctor as lastDoctor, t.diagnosis_result as lastDiagnosisResult, t.visit_type as lastVisitType, t.source_base_id as sourceBaseId, p.cat_name as catName, p.archive_no as archiveNo, p.base_id as baseId, p.ward_id as wardId, p.status as catStatus from ( select d.*, row_number() over (partition by d.cat_id order by d.visit_date desc, d.diagnosis_id desc) as rn, count(1) over (partition by d.cat_id) as visit_count, sum(case when d.visit_type = '1' then 1 else 0 end) over (partition by d.cat_id) as initial_count, min(d.visit_date) over (partition by d.cat_id) as first_visit, max(d.visit_date) over (partition by d.cat_id) as last_visit from cat_diagnosis d where d.del_flag = '0'
) t join cat_profile p on p.cat_id = t.cat_id where t.rn = 1 order by t.last_visit desc, t.cat_id desc

select count(1) from cat_diagnosis
AND del_flag = '0'

choose.otherwise: select count(distinct d.cat_id) from cat_diagnosis d where d.del_flag = '0' and exists (select 1 from cat_profile p where p.cat_id = d.cat_id and p.del_flag = '0' and p.status not in ('4', '5', '6'))

mapper.select: select w.ward_id as wardId, w.ward_name as wardName, w.base_id as baseId, b.base_name as baseName, (select count(1) from cat_profile p where p.ward_id = w.ward_id and p.del_flag = '0' and p.status not in ('4', '5', '6')) as catCount from cat_ward w left join cat_base b on b.base_id = w.base_id where w.del_flag = '0' and w.base_id = #{baseId} order by b.base_name, w.order_num, w.ward_id
select count(1) from cat_diagnosis where cat_id = #{catId} and del_flag = '0'

select p.cat_id as catId, p.cat_name as catName, p.archive_no as archiveNo, p.base_id as baseId, p.ward_id as wardId from cat_profile p where p.del_flag = '0' and p.status not in ('4', '5', '6') and p.ward_id = #{wardId} and p.base_id = #{baseId} and not exists (select 1 from cat_diagnosis d where d.cat_id = p.cat_id and d.del_flag = '0') order by p.ward_id, p.archive_no, p.cat_id limit 30

select u.user_id as userId, u.user_name as userName, u.nick_name as nickName from sys_user u join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.user_id join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' and r.status = '0' and r.role_key = 'doctor' group by u.user_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name order by u.user_id

select u.user_id as userId, u.user_name as userName, u.nick_name as nickName from sys_user u join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.user_id join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where u.user_id = #{userId} and u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' and r.status = '0' and r.role_key = 'doctor'

select u.user_id as userId, u.user_name as userName, u.nick_name as nickName from sys_user u join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.user_id join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where u.nick_name = #{nickName} and u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' and r.status = '0' and r.role_key = 'doctor' order by u.user_id limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into cat_diagnosis ( cat_id, base_id, source_base_id, ward_id, visit_date, visit_type, doctor, doctor_user_id, symptoms, diagnosis_result, weight, check_items, medical_advice, check_photos, correction_note, correction_by, correction_time, create_by, create_time )values( #{catId}, #{baseId}, #{sourceBaseId}, #{wardId}, #{visitDate}, #{visitType}, #{doctor}, #{doctorUserId}, #{symptoms}, #{diagnosisResult}, #{weight}, #{checkItems}, #{medicalAdvice}, #{checkPhotos}, #{correctionNote}, #{correctionBy}, #{correctionTime}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update:
update cat_diagnosis
cat_id = #{catId}, base_id = #{baseId}, source_base_id = #{sourceBaseId},
ward_id = #{wardId}, visit_date = #{visitDate}, visit_type = #{visitType}, doctor = #{doctor}, doctor_user_id = #{doctorUserId}, symptoms = #{symptoms}, diagnosis_result = #{diagnosisResult},
weight = #{weight}, check_items = #{checkItems}, medical_advice = #{medicalAdvice},
check_photos = #{checkPhotos}, correction_note = #{correctionNote}, correction_by = #{correctionBy}, correction_time = #{correctionTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate()
where diagnosis_id = #{diagnosisId}
update cat_diagnosis set ward_id = null, update_time = sysdate() where diagnosis_id = #{diagnosisId}
mapper.delete: update cat_diagnosis set del_flag = '2' where diagnosis_id = #{diagnosisId}
update cat_diagnosis set del_flag = '2' where diagnosis_id in #{id}
